# Rian Cullet

> Rian Cullet is a generational glass cullet business from Delhi, established in 1996. We collect, sort and process recycled glass cullet, serving customers pan-India.

- Established: 1996, Delhi, India (founder: Ms. Indu Bhatia)
- Serves: pan-India; 35+ companies in 22+ states
- Address: Khasra No. 45/23, 8 Tikri Kalan, Delhi 110041, India

- [Glass Cullet Supplier in Delhi](https://riancullets.com/glass-cullet-supplier-delhi/): Glass cullet supplier in Delhi since 1996. Factory, foreign and flint cullet, sorted by colour and processed for glass manufacturers across India. Enquire today.
- [Sell Glass Scrap](https://riancullets.com/glass-scrap-buyer-delhi/): Sell broken glass, waste bottles and factory glass scrap in Delhi NCR. Rian Cullet collects glass waste from factories, bottlers, hotels and scrap dealers for recycling.
- [Flint (Clear) Glass Cullet](https://riancullets.com/flint-glass-cullet/): Flint (clear / white) glass cullet, sorted away from amber and green for colourless glass production. Supplied pan-India by Rian Cullet, Delhi, since 1996.
- [Amber (Brown) Glass Cullet](https://riancullets.com/amber-glass-cullet/): Amber (brown) glass cullet, sorted by colour for manufacturers of amber bottles and jars. Supplied pan-India from Delhi by Rian Cullet. Send an enquiry.
- [Green Glass Cullet](https://riancullets.com/green-glass-cullet/): Green glass cullet sorted from mixed waste glass and processed for manufacturers of green bottles. Supplied pan-India from Delhi by Rian Cullet.
- [Glass Recycling in India](https://riancullets.com/glass-recycling-company-india/): How glass recycling works in India, from waste bottles to furnace-ready cullet, and how Rian Cullet has collected, sorted and processed glass in Delhi since 1996.
- [Glass Cullet FAQ](https://riancullets.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about glass cullet: what it is, factory vs foreign cullet, flint, amber and green, quality, pricing and pan-India supply from Delhi.
